title: 第二十五章 圆满凝基静待元婴第二十六章 极北寒原踏尽中千
content_zh:
黑风密林深处，长风穿林，叶落无声。
烬孤宸立在岩穴之外，一身布衣洗尽风尘，气息内敛如渊。
历经数月密林血战、灵气沉淀、法则微悟，他彻底坐稳金丹圆满。
自低凡世界起步，锻体、炼气、通脉、凝劲、筑基、金丹，六重境界，他无一日懈怠，无一步投机。
别人求机缘、求捷径、求天道眷顾。
他只凭肉身磨苦海，凭孤心镇万难，硬生生把每一个境界，都打磨到同阶极致圆满。
丹田之内，金丹浑圆无瑕，通体莹白，五行灵气循环不息，丝丝缕缕裹挟着粗浅的吞噬大道、空间大道纹路。
肉身经《寂骨锻体诀》绝境千炼，搭配《万象吞灵诀》无尽滋养，早已超脱普通金丹修士的体魄极限。
神识凝练澄澈，覆盖百里山林，细微风声、妖兽异动、灵气流转，尽在感知之中。
此刻的他，站在中千修真世界金丹之巅。
同阶无敌，跨阶可战。哪怕正面硬撼普通元婴初期修士，亦有周旋之力。
但烬孤宸心境古井无波。
金丹圆满，不是终点，只是通往元婴的门槛。
修真仙途，金丹筑基，元婴塑神。
金丹是肉身与灵气的极致，元婴是元神与大道的新生。
寻常修士凝婴，只求灵气足够、机缘到位、顺利破丹化婴即可，追求快速突破、快速长生。
烬孤宸不同。
他道心孤绝，一生求证唯一真道，绝不允许半分根基虚浮。
“丹未纯极，神未稳固，道未入微，不可化婴。”
他低声自语，目光淡漠望向无边密林。

寻常修士金丹圆满便可即刻冲击元婴。
他偏要——圆满之上，再磨极致。
他要把金丹底蕴、肉身强度、神识凝练、法则感悟，全部推到这片中千世界的规则极限，再行破丹化婴。
如此诞生的元婴，方能契合他未来纵横诸天、超脱混沌的孤烬真道，前路无漏、大道无缺。
自此，他不再刻意猎杀妖兽，不再赶路探地。
择密林最深处、灵气最纯粹的一座孤峰，静坐闭关。
白日吞吐天地灵气，熔炼金丹杂质，让丹体纯粹无瑕。
夜晚静守心神，以《九转元婴术》打磨元神雏形，养神、固神、凝神。
闲时观山林风雨、草木枯荣，默默感悟生死枯荣大道、阴阳大道的粗浅本源。
他修行从无枯燥，万法皆道，万物皆证。
时光平缓流淌，无波澜、无奇遇、无纷争。
一晃便是四月。
孤峰静坐，四载光阴浓缩四月光阴，烬孤宸彻底完成金丹极致圆满。
丹田金丹，褪去莹白，化作通透玉色，内外无瑕，每一缕灵气都精纯到骇人。
肉身筋骨，万劫不损，寻常中千世界灵宝，已难破其防。
元神雏形，凝实稳固，远超同阶修士数十倍底蕴。
五行、吞噬、空间、生死四大基础大道感悟，尽数踏入入门大成。
此时此刻，万事俱备，可凝元婴。
烬孤宸缓缓抬眸，望向中千修真世界的浩瀚天穹。
元婴一成，元神自主，寿元千载，可御空、可离体、可踏虚空、可初步挣脱地界束缚。

也是从元婴开始，修士才算真正踏入长生问道。
“破丹。”
一字落，道心定。
content_en:
Deep in the dark and windy forest, the wind blows through the forest and leaves fall silently.
Jin Guchen stood outside the cave, his cloth clothes washed away from the dust, and his breath was as restrained as an abyss.
After several months of bloody battles in the dense forest, the accumulation of spiritual energy, and the slight understanding of the laws, he was finally able to achieve the perfection of the golden elixir.
Starting from the low-mundane world, he has not slacked off for a day or speculated in the six realms of physical training, qi refining, meridians opening, energy condensation, foundation building, and golden elixir.
Others seek opportunities, shortcuts, and God's favor.
He only relied on his physical body to endure the sea of ​​suffering, relied on his lonely heart to overcome all difficulties, and forcibly polished every state to the same level of perfection.
Within the dantian, the golden elixir is round and flawless, and the whole body is crystal white. The spiritual energy of the five elements circulates endlessly, and the strands are wrapped in the rough lines of the Devouring Avenue and the Space Avenue.
The physical body scripture "Silent Bone Body Training Technique" has been practiced for thousands of times in desperate situations, coupled with the endless nourishment of "The Vientiane Soul Swallowing Technique", it has already surpassed the physical limits of ordinary golden elixir monks.
The spiritual consciousness is condensed and clear, covering hundreds of miles of mountains and forests. The subtle sounds of wind, the movements of monsters and beasts, and the flow of spiritual energy are all within the perception.
At this moment, he was standing on the top of the golden elixir of Zhongqian Cultivation World.
Invincible at the same level, but can fight across levels. Even if they challenge ordinary Yuanying early-stage monks head-on, they still have the power to deal with them.
But Jin Guchen's state of mind remained unchanged.
The perfection of the golden elixir is not the end, but the threshold to the Nascent Soul.
To cultivate the immortal path, the golden elixir builds the foundation, and the Nascent Soul builds the god.
The golden elixir is the ultimate of physical body and spiritual energy, and the Nascent Soul is the rebirth of the soul and the great road.
Ordinary monks who want to condense babies only need enough spiritual energy, the right opportunity, and the smooth breaking of the elixir to transform into babies. They pursue quick breakthroughs and quick immortality.
Jin Guchen is different.
His Taoist heart is lonely, and he spends his whole life seeking to prove the only true way, and will never allow half of his foundation to be frivolous.
"If the elixir is not pure, the spirit is not stable, and the Tao is not subtle, it cannot be transformed into a baby."
He whispered to himself, looking indifferently towards the boundless forest.
Ordinary monks can immediately attack the Nascent Soul when their golden elixir is perfected.
He insists on - to reach perfection and refine it to the extreme.
He wants to push the foundation of the golden elixir, the strength of his physical body, the condensation of his spiritual consciousness, and his understanding of the laws to the limit of the rules of this world, and then break the elixir and transform into an infant.
Only the Nascent Soul born in this way can fit in with his true path of Gu Jin that will span the heavens and transcend chaos in the future.
From then on, he no longer deliberately hunted monsters or traveled to explore the land.
Choose a solitary peak in the deepest part of the dense forest with the purest spiritual energy, and sit in meditation.
During the day, he breathed in the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, melted the impurities in the golden elixir, and made the elixir body pure and flawless.
Keep your mind quiet at night, polish the prototype of your soul with the "Nine Transformations of Yuanying Technique", nourish your mind, strengthen your mind, and concentrate your mind.
In my free time, I watch the wind and rain in the mountains and forests, the withering and flourishing of the vegetation, and silently comprehend the superficial origins of the avenue of life and death, the avenue of yin and yang.
His practice is never boring, all methods are Tao, and all things are realized.
Time flows gently, without waves, adventures, or disputes.
It's April in a flash.
Sitting quietly on the lonely peak, four years of time condensed into four months, Jin Guchen completely completed the ultimate perfection of the golden elixir.
The golden elixir in the dantian has faded away from its white color and turned into a transparent jade color. It is flawless inside and outside, and every ray of spiritual energy is so pure that it is shocking.
The physical body, muscles and bones are indestructible in all tribulations, and ordinary spiritual treasures from thousands of worlds can no longer break through its defenses.
The embryonic form of the soul is solid and stable, and its foundation is dozens of times higher than that of monks of the same level.
Comprehension of the four basic avenues of the Five Elements, Swallowing, Space, and Life and Death, all leading to the entry-level completion.
At this moment, everything is ready to condense the Nascent Soul.
Jin Guchen slowly raised his eyes and looked at the vast sky of Zhongqian Cultivation World.
Once the Nascent Soul is completed, the Yuan Shen is independent and has a life span of thousands of years. It can control the air, leave the body, step on the void, and initially break free from the constraints of the earth.
It is also from the Nascent Soul that monks can truly enter the realm of immortality.
"Broken Dan."
One word falls, and the Tao is determined.
